description: Redesign ALL four screens (profile, home, lesson, progress + lesson summary) to the polished Duolingo/Khan-Academy-Kids look using the FEAT-001 foundation, and wire the subtle animations and effect sounds. This is the main visual work: restyle the DOM the view modules produce, add per-module accent theming, effective module tiles, attractive badge/star cards, and tasteful motion + sound at the right moments. No maskotka/character is added. Learning behavior and the pure logic files stay untouched; Vitest stays green.
steps: Profile screen (docs/js/ui/profileView.js + styles.css): make 'Kto się dziś uczy?' a bold hero, restyle .profile-card into large, tactile, elevated cards with the avatar in a soft colored circle, and redesign the create-form: .avatar-grid choices as rounded chips with a clear selected state (colored ring/fill), a modern .name-input (rounded, clear focus ring), and the 'Zaczynamy! 🚀' primary 3D button. Add a gentle fade/slide-in entrance for the screen (respecting reduced-motion). Keep all Polish copy and the existing DOM structure/handlers intact; only adjust classes/markup as needed for styling.

Home hub (docs/js/ui/homeView.js + styles.css): redesign .home-header (avatar in a colored badge, greeting, animated total points/stars), the .home-prompt, and especially the .tile-grid: make each module tile a rich, rounded card using its accent color as a subtle gradient with the big emoji, title, and star subtitle, a soft shadow and a Duolingo-style press/hover micro-interaction and visible focus. Keep the fifth Postępy tile visually distinct (accent #B983FF). Keep the module accent colors and existing onClick handlers. Add a subtle count-up animation for the total points shown in the header (guard with prefers-reduced-motion).

Lesson screen (docs/js/ui/lessonView.js + styles.css): add an animated per-lesson PROGRESS BAR reflecting `Pytanie X / Y` (fills as questions advance), theme the screen with the current module's accent, and add smooth transitions between questions (fade/slide the prompt-card + answers on each presentCurrent, respecting reduced-motion). Redesign the .prompt-card variants (color swatch, big letter, big digit with apple count, english emoji+word) to look premium. Redesign .answer / .answer--color options into tactile 3D tiles with hover/active/focus-visible. On a CORRECT answer: keep the exact copy '🎉 Brawo!', trigger a tasteful, restrained celebration (e.g. a brief star/confetti sparkle or a gentle pop on the feedback banner) AND call soundEffects.playCorrect(); if the outcome includes newlyEarnedBadges, add a badge celebration animation + soundEffects.playBadge(). On a WRONG answer keep the gentle '🙂 Spróbuj jeszcze raz' with a soft, non-alarming shake/nudge (subtle, respecting reduced-motion). Do NOT change scoring, queue building, recordAnswer/recordLessonStars calls, speech calls, or any thresholds.

Lesson summary (docs/js/ui/lessonView.js + styles.css): redesign the finish screen ('Świetna robota!') into a celebratory card with animated star reveal (stars pop/scale in sequence based on starsForLesson result, reduced-motion aware), animated points count-up, and the two 3D buttons ('Jeszcze raz 🔁' primary, '⬅ Wróć do menu' secondary). Play a single restrained celebratory sound once on entry (reuse playBadge or a dedicated cue) - do not loop or overdo it.

Progress screen (docs/js/ui/progressView.js + styles.css): redesign 'Twoje postępy' with an attractive totals banner (animated), .module-card as polished cards each tinted with its module accent showing mastered X/total and its star row, and the badges section as a responsive GRID of attractive badge cards: earned badges get a vivid gradient + medal, locked badges get a tasteful muted/locked treatment with the encouraging Polish copy. Add a gentle staggered entrance for the cards (reduced-motion aware). Keep BADGES/content/counts and all copy unchanged.

Ensure the AudioContext resume happens on a genuine user gesture (e.g. first answer tap or profile selection) so effect sounds are allowed by browser autoplay policies; keep everything a no-op when muted or unsupported.

Confirm across all screens: consistent tokens, large child-friendly touch targets, strong contrast, visible focus everywhere, and that motion is subtle and fully disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.
Run `npm test` (must stay 35 green) and serve docs/ to smoke-test every screen and the full lesson flow.
acceptance_criteria: All four screens plus the lesson summary render with the new polished Duolingo/Khan-style look: gradients, rounded 3D buttons, per-module accent theming, effective tiles, attractive badge/star cards. No maskotka/character was added.
The lesson shows an animated progress bar tied to the question counter, smooth question transitions, and tactile answer tiles.

Correct answers show exact copy '🎉 Brawo!' plus a restrained celebration and play a short effect sound; a newly earned badge triggers a celebration + badge sound. Wrong answers show exact copy '🙂 Spróbuj jeszcze raz' with a gentle, non-alarming cue.
Effect sounds are subtle, short, respect the mute toggle, and no-op safely when Web Audio is unavailable. No binary audio files were added.
Animations are subtle throughout and are disabled/neutralized under prefers-reduced-motion.
Learning behavior is unchanged: no edits to docs/js/logic/*; `npm test` still passes 35 tests; scoring/stars/badges/queue/speech calls unchanged.
All copy remains in Polish and all asset paths remain relative; docs/.nojekyll still present.
verification: Run `npm test` from repo root and confirm 35 tests pass.

Run `python3 -m http.server -d docs 8000` and manually walk: create/select profile -> home tiles -> a full 6-question lesson in each module (verify correct '🎉 Brawo!' + sound + celebration, wrong '🙂 Spróbuj jeszcze raz', progress bar, 'Dalej ➡', summary stars) -> progress screen badges. Confirm no console errors.
Toggle the sound control and confirm effect sounds mute/unmute; set OS/browser reduced-motion and confirm animations are neutralized.
Reload after earning points and confirm progress persists in localStorage and the app still uses relative paths.
findings: Redesigned all four screens + lesson summary on top of the FEAT-001 foundation; touched only docs/css/styles.css and the four docs/js/ui/*View.js modules (dom.js needed no new helper). Vitest stays 35/35 green and no docs/js/logic/* file changed. PROFILE: hero title, elevated .profile-card with avatar in a soft colored circle (per-card --card-accent cycled through the five accents), modern create-form (avatar chips with clear selected ring/fill + aria-pressed, rounded .name-input with focus-shadow ring, 'Zaczynamy! 🚀' 3D button), .anim-fade-slide-in entrance. HOME: header as a surface card with avatar badge + greeting + a pill-styled totals; total points now count up from 0 (easeOutCubic via requestAnimationFrame, then .anim-count-up bounce, guarded by prefers-reduced-motion); tiles use each accent as a subtle gradient with a Duolingo 3D bottom edge (press sinks) via --tile-accent, big emoji/title/star-subtitle pill; the 5th Postępy tile gets .tile--progress distinct outline. Kept module accent colors and onClick handlers. LESSON: screen themed via --lesson-accent (COLORS #FF6B6B, LETTERS #4D96FF, NUMBERS #6BCB77, ENGLISH #FFA45B); animated .lesson-progress bar tied to 'Pytanie X / Y' (width transitions each question, role=progressbar with Polish aria-label); each question wrapped in .anim-fade-slide-in block; premium prompt-card variants and tactile 3D .answer tiles (hover/active/focus-visible). CORRECT keeps exact '🎉 Brawo!' + banner .anim-correct-pop + brief sparkle layer + soundEffects.playCorrect(); newlyEarnedBadges add .anim-badge-pulse + soundEffects.playBadge(). WRONG keeps exact '🙂 Spróbuj jeszcze raz' + a soft .answer--nudge shake on the tapped tile (retriggers via reflow). No change to scoring/queue/recordAnswer/recordLessonStars/speech/thresholds. SUMMARY: celebratory card with staggered star reveal (star-pop, animation-delay per earned star from starsForLesson), points count-up, the two 3D buttons ('Jeszcze raz 🔁' / '⬅ Wróć do menu'), single playBadge() cue on entry (no loop). PROGRESS: animated totals banner, .module-card tinted per accent (left border + gradient) with mastered X/total + star row, badges as a responsive grid (earned = gold->progress gradient + medal, locked = muted dashed card with unchanged encouraging copy 'Jeszcze chwila i ją zdobędziesz!'); gentle staggered .anim-fade-slide-in entrance. BADGES/counts/copy unchanged. AudioContext resumes on real user gestures: playTap() on profile select/create and the correct-answer tap call soundEffects, which lazily resume the context and no-op when muted/unsupported. All new motion is subtle and the prefers-reduced-motion block was extended to neutralize the new transforms, hide .sparkle-layer, freeze .star--reveal visible, and disable the progress-fill transition; JS also branches on matchMedia so entrance/count-up/sparkle/shake skip under reduced motion. Copy stays Polish, exact feedback strings preserved, no leading-slash local paths, .nojekyll untouched, no binary audio, no em dashes. VERIFICATION: `npm test` 35/35 green (before and after). A live browser could not reach the static server from the sandbox's browser network namespace (ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED) and no jsdom is installed, so I verified headlessly with a throwaway minimal-DOM Node harness (since removed) that rendered every screen and ran a full 6-question correct-answer lesson in all four modules: 5 home tiles incl. progress tile, animated progress bar present each question, exact '🎉 Brawo!' emitted, summary reached with stars + 'punktów' (60 pts = 6x10 under reduced-motion path), progress banner + 4 module cards + 6 badges. Both normal and prefers-reduced-motion:true paths passed with no exceptions. CSS braces balanced (151/151). Committed on branch main.
